instructions:
1. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding an ab wheel with both hands.
2. Bend at the hips and place the wheel on the floor in front of your feet, arms extended.
3. Brace your core and roll the wheel forward, extending your body until it is nearly straight.
4. Keep your back flat and avoid letting your hips sag.
5. Pull the wheel back toward your feet using your core to return upright.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Move slowly and under control through both phases.
2. Exhale as you roll out, inhale as you return.
3. Keep the lower back flat, never arched.
4. Squeeze your glutes to keep the pelvis stable.

instructions:
1. Step onto the stepmill and hold the side rails lightly for balance.
2. Select a pace and begin climbing, stepping fully onto each moving step.
3. Keep your torso upright and drive through the whole foot.
4. Maintain a steady rhythm without leaning on the rails.
5. Continue for the set duration, then step off carefully.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Stand tall and avoid hunching over the console.
2. Use the rails only for light balance, not to support your weight.
3. Push through the heels to emphasize the glutes.
4. Breathe steadily and keep a controlled cadence.

instructions:
1. Set the suspension trainer handles to about waist height.
2. Stand facing away from the anchor, holding a handle in each hand with arms in front.
3. Brace your core and lean forward, extending your arms overhead in a straight line from head to heels.
4. Lower until your arms are fully extended and you feel tension through the core.
5. Pull your arms back down to return your body to the upright start position.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you fall out, inhale as you return.
2. Keep your body rigid in a straight line from head to heels.
3. Move from the shoulders and core, keeping arms straight.
4. Step closer to the anchor to make it harder.

instructions:
1. Set the suspension trainer handles to about waist height.
2. Sit on the floor, knees bent and feet flat, holding a handle in each hand with a neutral grip.
3. Lean back and lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to knees.
4. Pull your chest toward the handles, bending the elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
5. Lower under control back to the starting position.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you pull up, inhale as you lower.
2. Lead with the elbows and squeeze the shoulder blades.
3. Keep the hips lifted so the body stays in a straight line.
4. Keep the shoulders down, away from the ears.

instructions:
1. Set the suspension trainer handles to about chest height.
2. Stand facing away from the anchor, feet shoulder-width apart, a handle in each hand.
3. Brace your core and lean forward, arms extended to the sides with a slight bend in the elbows.
4. Squeeze your chest to bring your hands together in front of you.
5. Open your arms back to the sides under control.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Exhale as you bring the hands together, inhale as you open.
2. Drive the movement with the chest, keeping a fixed elbow bend.
3. Keep the core tight so the hips do not sag.
4. Step forward to increase the difficulty.
